svg.text: CI/CD is GitHub Actions end to end. 37 components covering the 43-slot inventory. Every card sits at the height of what it connects to, so no line crosses another.
CUSTOMER NETWORK / AIR-GAP BOUNDARY — NO INBOUND PATH FROM THE VENDOR

g.text: we ship it or run it
24 marks are the real brand logos.
The CNCF glyph stands in for projects
with no mark in the set.
earns its place in split mode

svg.text: Traffic the runner starts arrives on
the bus at the right edge. Traffic the
platform starts arrives from the left.
direction is the column a firewall review reads — everything the cluster needs, it initiates

g.text: GHES → pipelines webhook route · HTTPS 443 via ingress · HMAC webhook secret · push, PR, workflow_run, App installation
ARC listener → GHES Actions · HTTPS 443 · GitHub App for ARC · polls for queued jobs, outbound only — no inbound port into the cluster
Runner pod → npm mirror · HTTPS 443 · read token · npm ci has no internet in an air-gap
GHES Actions → MinIO · HTTPS 9000 · S3 access key · artifacts and cache — GHES Actions will not start without S3-compatible storage
platform-ops → SMTP relay · TCP 587 STARTTLS · credential from Vault · notifications
Fluent Bit / Vector → their log sink · most customers want logs in their existing Splunk, not a second Grafana
Runner egress → Vault, Harbor, SonarQube · an Actions OIDC token is exchanged at Vault JWT auth for 10-minute credentials bound to repo · ref · env
Any context → Vault · HTTPS 8200 · Kubernetes ServiceAccount JWT · kv config, transit encryption, and the dynamic credential per CTX_DB_ROLE
Argo CD → Harbor · HTTPS 443 · robot pull account · resolves the pinned digest; it also pulls manifests from the GitOps repo on GHES
Argo CD → the platform release and customer workloads · applies the desired state; the runner never holds a kubeconfig
Runner pod → POST /ci/validate and /ci/report · HTTPS 443 · project-scoped aci_ token · an endpoint that already exists today
Any context → Postgres · TCP 5432 TLS · Vault dynamic credential · one database per install, one role per context
